newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's Sharper Image gyms put up for sale.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's Sharper Image gyms put up for sale.

text.p: The provisional liquidator for South Africa's International Class Gymnasium (Pty) Ltd said on Tuesday he had put the company's 30 fitness centres up for sale.

The businesses and assets of the gyms, which trade under the name The Sharper Image, range from Johannesburg to Cape Town. The liquidator gave no indication of the estimated value of the health clubs.
The concern went into provisional liquidation last week after a creditor obtained a court order against it for the recovery of some of its debts, which total 10 million rand.

Newspaper reports had originally said The Health & Raquet Club was mulling a bid for the group, but Nico Smuts, the financial director of holding firm LeisureNet, told local media this was not the case.
LeisureNet has been expanding recently, gaining South African rights for Planet Hollywood and buying golfing retail outlet Pro Shop for 70 million rand.
